scope: Current local macOS arm64 installed Node candidate movement and required local control/HTTPS/Python regression subset. Current full Linux matrix, full frozen Node contract closure, complete SDK/acceptance and publication remain separate.

hosting_build.scope: Local original production hosting test/CLI compilation only; no behavior qualification.

installed_candidate.scope: Actual local installed Node pending-candidate adoption and native decoded media; current authority, original-record recovery, helpers and servers drained. No Linux/remote/provider, full SDK or acceptance qualification.

node_control_regression.scope: Local installed Node original production native/HTTP control and causal recovery subset only. No candidate adoption, actual decoded media, Linux/remote/provider/full SDK or acceptance qualification.

https_regression.scope: Original local installed Node production HTTPS control only; not Linux/remote/media/full SDK/acceptance qualification.

python_native_regression.scope: Original local installed Python wheel/native helper/server control, restart, current authority and process ownership only; not Linux/remote/media/full SDK/acceptance qualification.

controlled_store_regression.scope: All controlled local Store native/telephone replacement source, reservation, custody, phase, commit, failure/recovery and native-wire regressions. No real Core ticket, signed host media, phone/provider or full SDK qualification.

identifier_policy: Ephemeral fixture identifiers in current control/HTTPS witnesses are SHA256 only; exact raw logs, IDs and owned process state remain private under.local.
